name: link2
description: Framed vehicle-state message to the sound/light ESP32 #2. The SHARED subset (Link2Frame/Link2Codec) is pure and dependency-free, which is what makes it liftable into the board-#2 project wholesale; only the control-side Link2Sender -- deliberately NOT part of the copy -- includes hal/IByteSink.hpp, and PlatformIO's LDF resolves that from the include itself.
